symbolDescription: A toolbar item, whether built-in or contributed by a plugin.

optionDescriptions.name: Unique within the toolbar.
optionDescriptions.icon: The control's icon, statically or derived from the current state.
optionDescriptions.label: The accessible name, and the visible one when labels are shown.
optionDescriptions.shortcut: Shown in the tooltip next to the label, e.g. `'Mod+B'`.
optionDescriptions.command: Command run by default when the item is activated.
optionDescriptions.isActive: Whether the control renders as pressed; the default reads `command`.
optionDescriptions.isDisabled: Whether the control renders as disabled; the default reads `canExec`.
optionDescriptions.onClick: Runs instead of `command` when the control is activated.
optionDescriptions.onSelect: Runs when a dropdown option is chosen.
optionDescriptions.render: Fully custom rendering, bypassing the button slots.
optionDescriptions.group: Logical grouping used by the slash menu and the overflow menu.
optionDescriptions.showIn: Surfaces this item may appear on.
optionDescriptions.order: Ordering hint inside a group; lower comes first.
